responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s abstract memory-region class hierarchy. It defines region kinds and memory spaces, the tree-shaped region model for roots, spaces, frames, declarations, fields, array elements, offsets, casts, sized subregions, dynamic allocations, strings, bit ranges, varargs, errno, and unknown regions, plus the keying/printing/size/offset interfaces that region_model and region_model_manager rely on to represent abstract storage precisely.
same_name_distinction: Defines the region type system itself—the region_kind taxonomy, memory_space enum, class hierarchy, and subclass key structures that region.cc then implements with operational methods like offset, size, ancestry, and pretty-printing behavior.
